<NAME_PLATE>

<NAME_PLATE>

<NAME_PLATE>

<NAME_PLATE>俺

<VOICE_PLAY>kar_v_sr399_0002_r18

<PAUSE>
<NAME_PLATE>

<PAUSE>

<NAME_PLATE>

<PAUSE>
<NAME_PLATE>

<NAME_PLATE>

<NAME_PLATE>

<NAME_PLATE>

<NAME_PLATE>俺
